summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — attested only in the Epitome list of wooers who came against Odysseus' house.

story.text: Apollodorus names Diopithes among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Ormenius and before Mecisteus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
